create_ProcessedJaxpr_make_from_func: create a ProcessedJaxpr from a JAX model function by tracing it and extracting layer and loss tags
build_cached_transformation: build a cached transformation wrapper that traces a function once and reuses the processed Jaxpr for repeated calls
run_loss_tags_vjp: run vector-Jacobian product computation over all registered loss tags in a traced model function
run_loss_tags_hvp: run Hessian-vector product computation over all registered loss tags using backward-over-forward autodiff
run_layer_tags_vjp: run vector-Jacobian product over all layer tags to obtain primal and tangent values for each layer
